about: FormulaEntry.CycleReference, F4 cycling the Reference at the caret (ADR-0051, 2026-09-29; SH-28): the engine's rewrite of the text being edited, as Excel does it (the seventeenth Windows run, Part C), and the span of what it rewrote. Where the grid leaves a caret at the span's end (typing left the caret, or while pointing), a case writes only selectionEnd; a run of presses is a case per press, each starting from the last one's answer. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' ReferenceCycleTests.
